title: Add a Gherkin runner without converting existing Jest tests
description:
Add a Gherkin runner in dataparade-cli for this initiative. Do not migrate existing Jest tests.

Recommended: cucumber-js with `features/` (or `tests/features/`) and a `pnpm test:features` script. jest-cucumber is acceptable if we must stay inside Jest, but Gherkin files should remain the source of truth.

Out of scope:
- Rewriting `tests/eval/layers/**/eval.test.ts`
- Rewriting scanner unit specs
- Implementing Plexus, Virtuus, or the detector Score

Pairs with Plexus behave features on plx-765ff0 / plx-3f0d47 for repo-local behavior. End-to-end operator scenarios live here and may shell out to `plexus` and the local GraphQL process.
